svg.aria-label: Map of the handbook: foundations feed core concepts, which feed patterns, which are applied in problems; technologies and DDIA chapters sit underneath; the interview playbook sits on top.
svg.title: Map of the handbook: foundations feed core concepts, which feed patterns, which are applied in problems; technologies and DDIA chapters sit underneath; the interview playbook sits on top.
svg.text: Every page links sideways: a problem links to the patterns it uses, and each pattern links to the DDIA chapter behind it.
